description: Add circuit breaker and backoff fields to resilience policy. Engine ResiliencePolicy supports Retry.BaseBackoff, Retry.MaxBackoff, and Breaker.{FailureThreshold, FailureRatio, OpenTimeout} but CMS only has Retry.MaxAttempts.
steps: 1. Edit /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync/cms/src/components/connection/retry-policy.json: Add baseBackoffMs (integer, min 0) and maxBackoffMs (integer, min 0) to attributes. These map to engine's Retry.BaseBackoff and Retry.MaxBackoff (the transform layer converts ms to Go duration).

2. Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync/cms/src/components/connection/breaker-policy.json with collectionName: components_connection_breaker_policies, displayName: breaker-policy. Attributes: failureThreshold (integer, min 1), failureRatio (float, min 0, max 1), openTimeoutMs (integer, min 1000). These map to engine resilience.go Breaker struct fields.

3. Edit /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync/cms/src/components/connection/resilience-policy.json: Add a breaker component reference: "breaker": {"type": "component", "repeatable": false, "component": "connection.breaker-policy"}.
acceptance_criteria: retry-policy.json has maxAttempts, baseBackoffMs, maxBackoffMs attributes
breaker-policy.json exists with failureThreshold, failureRatio, openTimeoutMs attributes
resilience-policy.json has timeoutMs, retry component, and breaker component
verification: Run: cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync/cms && npm run build 2>&1 | head -50 — should complete without schema errors
Check that each modified/new JSON file is valid JSON: cat <file> | jq .
findings: All three acceptance criteria met: retry-policy.json now has maxAttempts, baseBackoffMs, maxBackoffMs; breaker-policy.json created with failureThreshold, failureRatio, openTimeoutMs; resilience-policy.json has timeoutMs, retry component, and breaker component. CMS build passes.
